item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President ceremonially proclaims a commemorative month; this does not govern agencies or alter legal rights or duties.","evidence":"do hereby proclaim November 2021 as National Veterans and Military Families Month"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President makes a hortatory appeal to the public, not a binding direction to an agency or an alteration of legal rights.","evidence":"call upon the people of the United States to honor veterans and military families"}]}
